title: Make the XOR of All Segments Equal to Zero
summary: Given an array and an integer k, determine the least number of element changes needed so that the XOR of every segment of size k equals zero.
statement: Given an array and an integer k, determine the least number of element changes needed so that the XOR of every segment of size k equals zero.
constraints: All length-k segments must have XOR zero after changing as few elements as possible.
Values are between 0 and 1023; overlapping windows force indices with the same remainder modulo k to share a value.
hints: All positions with the same index modulo k must become equal.
Treat each remainder class as a group and keep the cheapest cost for every possible accumulated XOR.
For each group, either choose a value already present or pay to replace the entire group with another value.
The 1024 XOR states cover every possible value; group DP minimizes changes, and state zero after all k groups is exactly the required repeating-block XOR.
editorial: The 1024 XOR states cover every possible value; group DP minimizes changes, and state zero after all k groups is exactly the required repeating-block XOR.

tests.explanation: With k=1 every element must be zero, so the three nonzero values change.
Changing one value in each remainder group yields repeating triples whose XOR is zero.
